name: Ophelia
message: King Hamlet. I thought he was dead.

name: Quince
message: Oh, he was. Is. But death isn't quite so linear as all that. As you've no doubt observed!

name: Quince
message: You see, you both share some unfinished business. As do I.

name: Ophelia
message: What business is that?

name: Quince
message: The same business which keeps you trapped in this world, repeating indefinitely.

name: Quince
message: And so shall it continue until you follow this thread where it might lead.

name: Ophelia
message: Wait. What's happened to Hamlet? His eyes... they're... empty.

name: Quince
message: Ah. He is, shall we say, on pause.

name: Quince
message: One moment.

name: Quince
message: There we are.

name: Hamlet
message: His death—I've seen it with my own eyes! And the traitor is my own blood, and my mother-- Oh, dear God, my mother!

name: Hamlet
message: Worms, worms and wriggling earth! All I can see is bile and rot everywhere!

name: Ophelia
message: Listen, Hamlet. Your father's ghost? I've seen him, too.

name: Hamlet
message: What?

name: Ophelia
message: I believe you, Hamlet. I believe you saw your father's spirit. You're not insane.

name: Hamlet
message: Y-you—?

name: Ophelia
message: Now, tell me: Where did you see this spirit, and when?

name: Hamlet
message: M-midnight. On the walls. It was around the witching hour. But how did you--

name: Hamlet
message: I—

name: Ophelia
message: Midnight, on the walls. That's what he said.
